title: Maximum-Volume Nonnegative Matrix Factorization
abstract: arXiv:2602.04795v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF) is a popular data embedding technique. Given a nonnegative data matrix $X$, it aims at finding two lower dimensional matrices, $W$ and $H$, such that $X\approx WH$, where the factors $W$ and $H$ are constrained to be element-wise nonnegative. The factor $W$ serves as a basis for the columns of $X$. In order to obtain more interpretable and unique solutions, minimum-volume NMF (MinVol NMF) minimizes the volume of $W$. In this paper, we consider the dual approach, where the volume of $H$ is maximized instead; this is referred to as maximum-volume NMF (MaxVol NMF). MaxVol NMF is identifiable under the same conditions as MinVol NMF in the noiseless case, but it behaves rather differently in the presence of noise. translated_title: 最大体积非负矩阵分解
translated_abstract: 非负矩阵分解（NMF）是一种流行的数据嵌入技术。给定一个非负数据矩阵 $X$，它旨在找到两个较低维度的矩阵 $W$ 和 $H$，使得 $X\approx WH$，其中因子 $W$ 和 $H$ 被约束为逐元素非负。因子 $W$ 作为 $X$ 列的基础。为了获得更可解释和唯一的解，最小体积NMF（MinVol NMF）最小化 $W$ 的体积。在本文中，我们考虑对偶方法，即最大化 $H$ 的体积；这被称为最大体积NMF（MaxVol NMF）。在无噪声情况下，MaxVol NMF 在相同条件下与 MinVol NMF 可识别，但在存在噪声时行为相当不同。在实践中，MaxVol NMF 在提取稀疏分解方面更有效，并且不会产生秩亏解。事实上，我们证明了 MaxVol NMF 的解具有某些性质。
tldr: 本文提出最大体积非负矩阵分解（MaxVol NMF），通过最大化因子体积而非最小化，在噪声环境下更有效地提取稀疏分解且避免秩亏解，并证明其可识别性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Maximum-Volume NMF (MaxVol NMF), which maximizes factor volume instead of minimizing it, enabling more effective sparse decomposition and avoiding rank-deficient solutions under noise, with proven identifiability.
